quests.title: The Weighed Tribute
quests.premise: Redistributed grain is short by the same fraction at every stage. The loss is in the weighing. The loss is not in the carrying.

quests.title: A Death Inside the Grove
quests.premise: A delegate is dead inside a grove. No blade may be carried in the grove. The open question is what was carried instead.

quests.title: The Blank Line in the Register
quests.premise: One stage of the passenger register carries a paid fare. The fare stands against a name. No poler can place that name on any hull.

quests.title: Seats Cut and Recut
quests.premise: Two tribes claim the same worn seat. One tribe has cut its mark deeper than the other.

quests.title: Cast, Not Tuned
quests.premise: Cast chimes are sold in the Helstrom market. They carry a forged tuning mark. Half the district's prayers are wrong as a result.

quests.title: Three Short and One Long
quests.premise: Something on the gate approach has learnt the lantern rhythm. The basin guides use that rhythm to answer each other.

quests.title: The Sweet Water Turns
quests.premise: The city spring runs sour on a cycle. The assembly declines to time the cycle in open session.

quests.title: Light Sold by the Jar
quests.premise: Farmed gallery fungus enters the city untaxed. It travels under the assembly's own carrying licences.

quests.title: The Poles by the Door
quests.premise: Finished grave-poles arrive at Helstrom houses. The houses ordered none. The poles are cut with the names of the living.

quests.title: The Unstood Turn
quests.premise: A rite needs a tribe that has missed three convocations. The assembly must decide who may stand in its place.

quests.title: Two Names on One Chair
quests.premise: A naheesh dies. The office was promised to a child of eleven. A sister who has done the work for years claims it.

quests.title: The Owing Paid in Passage
quests.premise: A porter works an Owing off in rootworm fares. The Owing is entered in the ledger again from the start each time.

quests.title: Written on the Urn
quests.premise: A Helstrom family's name is shelved in the vault. It is shelved under an offence. The offence was pardoned two generations ago.

quests.title: Four Hundred and Eleven
quests.premise: The refuge stores are counted for a population that was last surveyed forty years ago. A surveyor must walk out and count the stores again.

quests.title: The Fare or the Favour
quests.premise: The Waykeepers will carry the assembly's grain. The assembly cannot pay their price in coin.

quests.title: It Keeps Its Circle
quests.premise: The ground stays bare for two metres out from the standing thing. Four stories are told about the standing thing. Two of the four stories turn the bare ground to profit.

quests.title: The Lifted Rota
quests.premise: A stage has been cut out of the tending rota. The rota is carved down the door jamb. The cut takes three hundred years of turns with it.

quests.title: The Grove's Own Shade
quests.premise: The roofing of a market row is killing a limb of the grove. The traders and the tree-minders each hold a case. The assembly will hear both cases.

quests.title: The Line That Ends Early
quests.premise: The lamp-keeper's round runs on the semi-public underway. The round now stops at the first junction. The round used to stop at the second junction.

quests.title: The Roost Moves
quests.premise: Two hundred birds have shifted their dawn line onto the grove approach. The birds take whatever the market carries.

quests.title: A Second Timetable
quests.premise: The working rootworm exit runs for an hour. The honest posted timetable leaves that hour out.

quests.title: The Sermon a Day Short
quests.premise: A Nisswo has painted a sermon inside the last rest house. The assembly wants the sermon gone before the convocation.

quests.title: The Chime That Names the Heir
quests.premise: The inheritance of a household turns on a chime. The chime is tuned to a tree. The tree has since been felled.

quests.title: Held for the Season
quests.premise: A debtor is held under a custom. The custom lapses when the convocation closes. For that reason the convocation keeps being postponed.

quests.title: The Sky Cut Open
quests.premise: Stones keep a sky-view for the convocation. The stones have begun to disagree with the season. The stones are cut to read that season.

quests.title: Tuned Against a Dead Tree
quests.premise: A chime was commissioned for a tree. The tree died between the order and the tuning. Both parties are out of pocket.

quests.title: The Withdrawn Qualification
quests.premise: The tuning qualification of a maker was pulled six years ago. The ruling was issued by word only.

quests.title: The Frame That Answers
quests.premise: One frame in the field of two hundred rings without wind. The ringing follows a pattern. A watcher has begun to record the pattern.

quests.title: Three Claims on One Egg
quests.premise: Three tribes claim a share of the Mnemic Egg. One tribe makes its claim publicly. A refusal now looks like hoarding.

quests.title: The Egg Room Opened
quests.premise: The reliquary inside the dead trunk was opened from within the village. The opener knew the order of the wrappings.

quests.title: What the Dead Trunk Holds
quests.premise: The village refuses to leave the trunk. The trunk has begun answering at night. The custodians will not describe the voice.

quests.title: The Maintenance Ledger
quests.premise: The repair ledger of the keepers bills four tribes. The bills are for spans that were left unrebuilt.

quests.title: Under the Fourth Arm
quests.premise: Something has taken up residence beneath the deck that carries the shrine. It lives at the least used arm of the deck.

quests.title: The Coordinated Tolls
quests.premise: Two junctions have begun to coordinate their tolls. Tribes that use both junctions want one rate or none at all.

quests.title: The Sapling's First Naming
quests.premise: The carried cutting is old enough for children to be named at it. The tribes have no agreement on who may stand for a tree that young.

quests.title: Two Days of Root
quests.premise: The replanted sapling is failing. The soil that it was carried in is under suspicion. The soil was gathered two days back along the walk.

quests.title: Water Without Ceremony
quests.premise: Two delegations would not pay the pitch rent of Nine-Trunks. The two delegations lodge here instead. They want the use of the spring written down before the next convocation.

quests.title: The Drinker at the Spring
quests.premise: A body lies in the water that the interior drinks without ceremony. Two households at the spring would prefer that the matter stay unraised.

quests.title: Grain Counted Twice
quests.premise: Two villages hold receipts against the same stored grain. The same storekeeper stamped both sets of receipts.

quests.title: The Staddle Post Cut
quests.premise: A granary is emptied with its lock untouched. The thief must be a person who knew the weak side of the post.

quests.title: Stored Against a Person
quests.premise: A village has pledged the labour of a household against its grain deposit. The village did not tell the household.

quests.title: New Courses on Old Stone
quests.premise: A tribe is laying fresh courses on Merethic stone. The tribe is called to answer for it in front of the convocation.

quests.title: Consecrating Bad Work
quests.premise: A Nisswo is asked to bless courses that the masons built. The masons admit that the courses are worse than the Merethic stone beneath them.

quests.title: The Plan Behind the Stone
quests.premise: The new courses have begun to complete a plan. The plan was drawn before the current masons were born.

quests.title: Born Onto the Roster
quests.premise: A child was entered on the watch roster at birth. The child wants off the roster. The village treats that wish as desertion.

quests.title: Behind the Sealed Door
quests.premise: The village guards something that can be reached without its leave. The route lies past the ward that holds the dry approach.

quests.title: The Pole Not Collected
quests.premise: A finished grave-pole has stood by the door for eleven years. The family that it names cannot be found.

quests.title: Cord and Paint
quests.premise: Grave-pole cord is being rebound with the wrong tribal marks. The wrong marks enter the dead in the wrong ledger.

quests.title: Led by the Wrist
quests.premise: A visitor walked through the village on the chime-lines. The visitor arrives lighter. The visitor cannot describe what left.

quests.title: The Chime-Lines Sicken
quests.premise: A saboteur is fouling the chime-lines with a paste that dulls them. The village steers by the chime-lines after dark.

quests.title: Pitch-Rights
quests.premise: The village rents convocation pitch at a high rate. Because of the high rate, two delegations have camped elsewhere.

quests.title: One Tree or Nine
quests.premise: A felling claim turns on a ring of trunks. By the reckoning of the Hist the ring is one tree. By the reckoning of the tribes the ring is nine trees.

quests.title: Under the Overflow
quests.premise: Goods move into the convocation inside delegation baggage. The village is paid to leave the baggage shut.

quests.title: Four Villages Down
quests.premise: The pile stumps of four earlier villages still hold what each village left. The water has dropped far enough to reach the stumps.

quests.title: The Fifth Set of Piles
quests.premise: Piles are being driven at night in the old field. The piles are for a village that has no builder behind it.

quests.title: Under the Stumps
quests.premise: Something dens in the drowned pile fields. It takes from the village that stands above the pile fields.

quests.title: Boards That Disagree
quests.premise: Every house keeps its own toll board. A carrier who used four landings has been charged four different ways.

quests.title: Off the Landing Ladder
quests.premise: A toll collector drowns at his own ladder. The water is a metre deep. His board has been freshly repainted.

quests.title: The House With No Board
quests.premise: One house takes no landing fee. After dark the house is busier than the poling quay.

quests.title: The Concession Runs Out
quests.premise: An Imperial concession has lapsed. Factors who hold no writ are enforcing it over the warehouse stock.

quests.title: Named by Register
quests.premise: A Hist would witness a naming. The naming must be done by register and witness. One of the witnesses refuses to sign.

quests.title: The Dry Magazine
quests.premise: The dry magazine of the interior is storing cargo. The register of the station itself declines to list that cargo.

quests.title: The Trial at Greenspring
quests.premise: A Root Steward of Hissmir, who cannot refuse a comer, gives the Trial of the Burnished Scales at Greenspring until Hissmir is built.
